prompt_en: Create a photorealistic wide environmental portrait at first light after an overnight sleet squall. Show an ordered alpine forest-krummholz-tundra ecotone: a complete alpine treeline ecotone gradient running upslope from dense lower forest through sparse upright trees and wind-pruned krummholz to open alpine tundra. Across the continuous slope, a dense continuous lower-slope forest forms the base of the elevation sequence beneath the rising saddle; trees become visibly shorter and more widely spaced farther upslope across the middle transition; a distinct band of low wind-shaped flagged or mat-like woody growth occupies the upper transition; treeless alpine meadow tundra or exposed ground continues above the krummholz band. On a volcanic saddle above a cloud-filled valley, place an unmistakably adult mountain cartographer whose general facial appearance and long dark softly waved hair follow the supplied appearance reference, reading a folded contour map while standing on a volcanic saddle above a cloud-filled valley. The medium-full cartographer occupies about one quarter of the lower-right frame, with face, natural skin texture, and wind-tossed hair clearly readable while all four vegetation bands remain open around the figure. An oblique cross-slope viewpoint lets the eye climb diagonally through all four vegetation bands. Deep focus keeps both the cartographer's face and every vegetation band sharply legible across the saddle. Broken backlight separates the rising valley mist from each wet vegetation band. Sleet beads on a practical red weather shell; wet grass, dark volcanic rocks, map creases, and lifting cloud carry coherent documentary texture.
